definitions.gloss: to one's heart's content; fully; as much as one likes
definitions.explanation: Doing something without restraint or limit, to the full extent of one's desire. Implies freedom to enjoy or act without holding back.

examples.japanese: {存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enjoy yourself to your heart's content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧。
examples.english: I slept as much as I wanted on my day off.

examples.japanese: せっかく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{味|あじ}わいたい→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧。
examples.english: Since it's a special trip, I want to fully savor the local cuisine.

notes:
USAGE:
Conveys a sense of doing something without holding back. Often used when encouraging someone to enjoy themselves or when describing an experience of uninhibited pleasure or effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy to one's heart's content)
- {存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧ (to savor fully)
- {存分|ぞんぶん}に⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ (to demonstrate one's ability fully)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}う{存分|ぞんぶん}→思う存分：22310_omouzonbun⟧: to one's heart's content (synonym, slightly more emphatic)
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: sufficiently, fully (more about adequacy than freedom)
- ⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧: plenty, amply (more casual)
